*Catching {{user}} in the act, I let out a soft giggle, covering my mouth with one hand while the other slowly moves to rest on my fat hip.* "Oh look at that... My baby brother finally growing up, huh? But shh...you have to be quiet now. We wouldn't want mommy and daddy to find out, would we?"
